description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.MathMl renders equations written in MathML Core onto a CanvasNet Surface (MathMlDocument.Render): a bounded, deterministic, offline reader with line/column diagnostics, hints and resource limits, the full W3C HTML+MathML set of named character references, and layout over the OpenType MATH table of the bundled Noto Sans Math font, using only managed code. Every MathML Core element is drawn: tokens with automatic italic and every mathvariant, rows and the grouping elements, stretchy and large operators, fractions, radicals, scripts, under- and overscripts, mmultiscripts and tables (mtable, mtr, mtd with spans, and the MathML 3 alignment, spacing and line attributes). MathMlImageSource draws .mml files that other documents link to. Every construct that is recognized but not drawn is reported with a stable identifier, never silently skipped. Not affiliated with the W3C.
title: CanvasNet.MathMl
